subtitulo: Application configuration. Whatever you change here takes precedence over the .env file.

almacen.texto: In the auxiliary database (data/aux.sqlite), separate from the RDF store. The API key is stored unencrypted on your machine and is never shown.

llm.descripcion: The internal assistant uses this model, usually a local one. External MCP agents use their own.
llm.modeloAyuda: Model name as the server knows it (e.g. qwen3:8b). “Test connection” lists the available ones.
llm.claveAyuda: Only for services that require it. Local servers don't.
llm.contextoAyuda: Sets how much lore and data is sent to it.
llm.reintentosAyuda: If it proposes invalid data, it is asked to fix it.
llm.modeloNoEncontrado: the configured model is not in the list
llm.modoSalidaAyuda: How the AI generator asks models (especially small local ones) for structured JSON. If your model fails when generating, try another mode.

modoDesc.tool: The model answers by calling a tool. Most compatible with models that support tools.
modoDesc.native: The server enforces JSON matching the schema. Useful if your server supports it (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM).
modoDesc.prompted: The schema goes in the instructions and the text is parsed. For models without tools or structured output.

identidad.descripcion: How your changes appear in provenance.
identidad.nombreAyuda: Recorded as the author of each change (PROV-O).

mundo.descripcion: Federated queries and the “Real world” panel on entity sheets.
mundo.agenteAyuda: Wikidata requires a contact URL or e-mail; without it, it answers 403.

sparql.descripcion: Limits for the SPARQL editor and the agents' consultar_sparql tool.
